HomePage.title: Connect Without Limits
HomePage.description: A modern, bilingual, secure and fast messaging platform. Chat with your friends anytime, anywhere.
HomePage.feature1Desc: Send and receive messages in real-time with zero delay.
HomePage.feature2Desc: Supports Arabic and English with automatic text direction switching.
HomePage.feature3Desc: Your conversations are protected by Supabase Row-Level Security.
